items.stem: A backtest uses each bar's closing price to decide a trade and assumes the fill happens at that same close. Why is this a problem?

options.text: It assumes information available only at the close can be acted on at the close, a form of lookahead bias
options.rationale: Correct: deciding and filling on the same close is unrealistic and inflates results through lookahead.
Closing prices are recorded; the issue is acting on them simultaneously.

options.text: It makes the backtest run too slowly
options.rationale: The problem is bias in results, not speed.

options.text: Backtests cannot use daily bars at all
options.rationale: Daily bars are fine; the timing assumption is the flaw.

items.explanation: Correct: deciding and filling on the same close is unrealistic and inflates results through lookahead.

items.stem: Which TWO practices make a backtest more honest? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Validating on out-of-sample data the rules were not tuned on
options.rationale: Correct: out-of-sample testing checks for overfitting.

options.text: Re-tuning parameters until the equity curve looks perfect
options.rationale: That is curve-fitting, which makes the backtest misleading.

options.text: Removing all losing trades from the historical record
options.rationale: Deleting losses fabricates performance and destroys validity.

items.stem: What is the main purpose of a kill switch in a live algorithmic system?

options.text: To halt trading automatically when predefined risk or error conditions are met
options.rationale: Correct: a kill switch stops the system when something goes wrong, limiting damage.

options.text: To guarantee the strategy is always profitable
options.rationale: A kill switch limits losses; it cannot guarantee profit.
Its purpose is safety, not latency reduction.

options.text: To replace the need for backtesting
options.rationale: A kill switch is a live safeguard, not a substitute for testing.

items.explanation: Correct: a kill switch stops the system when something goes wrong, limiting damage.
